This test verifies that dotted text without a scheme is only linkified
when its host ends in a common top-level domain (golang/go#70033).

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.18
-- a/a.go --
package a //@documentlink(links)

import _ "example.com/b"

var _ = []string{
	"p.name is %q",
	"go.dev is my favorite site!",
	"https://p.name is not a real site!",
}

// See example.com/doc or https://go.dev/doc.
-- b/b.go --
package b
-- @links --
a/a.go:3:11-24 https://pkg.go.dev/example.com/b
a/a.go:7:3-9 https://go.dev
a/a.go:8:3-17 https://p.name
a/a.go:11:8-23 https://example.com/doc
a/a.go:11:27-45 https://go.dev/doc
